source_refs.note: 9. Controlling epidemics: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 189-189.

blocks.text: Waba (epidemic) ke dauran biostatistics bimari ke phailao ka peecha karne, mortality rate (amwaat ki sharah) ka andaza lagane aur khatre wali population pehchanne mein bohat ahem hai. Yeh fauri (real-time) analysis faisle karne mein madad deta hai aur aise khaas iqdamaat karwata hai jo outbreak (bimari ka achanak phailao) ko roken aur us ke asraat kam karein.
